note: Arcadia's library: the game list on the left (home, a filter, search, collections that fold, each game in its play-state colour), the home (what's new, recent games by day, a shelf per collection and every game sorted) and a page per game (the banner with its logo, play and the stats, the sections, the activity and the side panels).

computed.libList: {{sort(filter(computed.owned, (!state.readyOnly || it.installed) && (!state.favOnly || it.favourite) && (empty(state.query) || fuzzy(state.query, it.title) != null)), state.recentFirst ? it.lastPlayed ?? 0 : lower(it.title), state.recentFirst ? 'desc' : 'asc')}}
computed.sections: {{concat([{ id: 'favourites', title: t('lib.favourites'), ids: map(filter(computed.owned, it.favourite), it.id) }], state.collections, [{ id: 'uncategorised', title: t('lib.uncategorised'), ids: map(filter(computed.owned, !it.favourite && !contains(computed.collected, it.id)), it.id) }])}}
computed.recentGroups: {{filter([{ label: t('time.today'), games: filter(computed.recent, state.today - it.lastPlayed < 86400000) }, { label: t('time.yesterday'), games: filter(computed.recent, state.today - it.lastPlayed >= 86400000 && state.today - it.lastPlayed < 172800000) }, { label: t('time.thisWeek'), games: filter(computed.recent, state.today - it.lastPlayed >= 172800000 && state.today - it.lastPlayed < 604800000) }, { label: t('time.lastWeek'), games: filter(computed.recent, state.today - it.lastPlayed >= 604800000 && state.today - it.lastPlayed < 1209600000) }, { label: t('time.earlier'), games: filter(computed.recent, state.today - it.lastPlayed >= 1209600000) }], length(it.games) > 0)}}
computed.allGames: {{settings.library.sortBy == 'playtime' ? sort(computed.owned, it.hours, 'desc') : settings.library.sortBy == 'recent' ? sort(computed.owned, it.lastPlayed ?? 0, 'desc') : sort(computed.owned, lower(it.title))}}
computed.lastPlayed: {{computed.game.lastPlayed == null ? t('time.never') : state.today - computed.game.lastPlayed < 86400000 ? t('time.today') : state.today - computed.game.lastPlayed < 172800000 ? t('time.yesterday') : formatDate(computed.game.lastPlayed, 'd MMM', 'utc')}}

do.to: {{some(computed.sections, !(state.collapsed[it.id] ?? false)) ? fromEntries(map(computed.sections, { key: it.id, value: true })) : {}}}

toggleFilter.title: Turn a library filter on or off
toggleFilter.description: key is readyOnly, favOnly, recentFirst or showNews.

editNote.title: Write a note about a game

install.title: Install
install.description: Queues the game, or its update: it downloads at once if nothing else is.

do.if: {{find(data.games, it.id == id) != null && find(state.downloads, it.id == id && it.status != 'done') == null}}

then.value: {{{ id: id, sizeGb: find(data.games, it.id == id).status == 'update' ? 1.2 : find(data.games, it.id == id).sizeGb, doneGb: 0, status: computed.download ? 'queued' : 'downloading', kind: find(data.games, it.id == id).status == 'update' ? 'update' : 'install' }}}

toggleFavourite.title: Add to or remove from favourites

setSort.title: Sort the library
setSort.description: Sorts All Games by name, hours played or last played.

noteDialog.note: A note about a game, kept with it in the library.

libraryPage.note: The library: the game list on the left, the home or a game's page on the right.

librarySidebar.note: Home, the games filter with recent-first and ready-to-play, search, and the games by collection.

gameRow.note: A game in the list: its cover as an icon and its name in its play-state colour, with what it is doing.

capsule.note: A game's cover, 2:3, that lifts and glows under the pointer; dimmed when the game isn't installed.

libraryHome.note: The library's home: what's new, recent games grouped by day, a shelf per collection and every game.

children.height: {{412 + 286 * length(filter(computed.sections, it.id != 'uncategorised' && length(it.ids ?? it.games) > 0)) + 239 * ceil(length(computed.owned) / max(1, floor(((nodes['home-scroll'].width ?? 1008) - 42) / 164)))}}

bigCapsule.note: The latest game played, wide: its banner and logo, play time and a play button.

gamePage.note: A game's page: the banner and logo, play and the stats, the sections, the activity and the side panels.

children.height: {{max(700, 150 + length(filter(data.activity, it.game == g.id)) * 96 + length(filter(data.news, it.game == g.id)) * 120)}}

children.text: {{t('game.unlocked', { got: g.achievements[0], total: g.achievements[1], percent: floor(g.achievements[0] / max(1, g.achievements[1]) * 100) })}}
